post.summary: Create a listing draft (step 1 of listing creation)
post.description: Bearer auth. Body is the draft payload (propertyType, propertySubType, status ForSale|ForRent, location {latitude, longitude, addressDisplay, city, …}, askAmount, askCurrency, description, fields). Then upload photos with POST /api/v1/listings/{id}/media and publish with POST /api/v1/drafts/{id}/publish.

post.summary: Publish a draft (makes it live on the map)
post.description: Bearer auth; the draft must have at least one photo, a location and a price. Published listings are field- and photo-frozen.

400.description: Invalid value for: query parameter limit, Invalid value for: query parameter offset

post.description: Paginated listing search over a viewport (boundsSW/boundsNE) or a drawn polygon (area), with type/sub-type, status, price, area, dynamic-field, seller-type and place-name (q/city/district) filters. Agents usually prefer the flat GET /api/v1/listings form, which folds into this same request. Response: {data:{listings:[ListingQuickView…], total, limit, offset}}.

get.description: Full public record of an ever-published listing: type, location (lat/lng, address, city, state, country), description, price (askAmount + askCurrency; askAreaUnit set = a per-unit RATE, askAmountTotal = the total), fields, media. Response: {data: Listing}. Drafts are not served here (404).
